## File: facebookresearch_spot-sim2real/spot_rl_experiments/spot_rl/real_policy.py

Prompts

```
['create a GazePolicy instance from a checkpoint path and device for arm gaze control', 'create a NavPolicy instance from a checkpoint path and device for robot navigation', 'create a PlacePolicy instance from a checkpoint path and device for object placement', 'create a MixerPolicy that combines nav, gaze, and place expert policies into one', 'run the act method on a RealPolicy to get actions from observations', 'run the SpotRosVisualizer to display ROS camera images from a Boston Dynamics Spot robot in real time', 'run the SpotRosVisualizer in headless mode without opening a GUI window for server-side image processing', 'run the SpotRosVisualizer with the --record flag to automatically capture and save video of robot camera feeds', 'review the VisualizerMixin overlay_text method that overlays multi-line text on OpenCV images with configurable color and size', 'review the SpotRosVisualizer generate_composite method that stacks raw and processed ROS camera images into a single composite view']
```

```
{'create_GazePolicy': 'create a GazePolicy instance from a checkpoint path and device for arm gaze control', 'create_NavPolicy': 'create a NavPolicy instance from a checkpoint path and device for robot navigation', 'create_PlacePolicy': 'create a PlacePolicy instance from a checkpoint path and device for object placement', 'create_MixerPolicy': 'create a MixerPolicy that combines nav, gaze, and place expert policies into one', 'run_RealPolicy_act': 'run the act method on a RealPolicy to get actions from observations'}
```
